mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, directly increasing present value of future earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Inflation exceeding 3.5% annual rate triggers aggressive central bank tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuation multiples, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 150k) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) signal robust consumer spending capacity, boosting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns within 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS>150k and UNRATE<4.0%) fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 2.0% annualized) indicates sustained corporate earnings momentum, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 exceeds 2.0% annualized during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production contraction below 100.0 signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate capital expenditure and causing negative S&P 500 returns within 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction activity above 1.6 million units (HOUST > 1600.0) indicates strong housing market demand, boosting consumer confidence and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1600.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent industrial production decline (INDPRO < 100.0) and falling retail sales (RSAFS < 700k) signal broad economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (INDPRO<100.0 and RSAFS<700k) fails to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), economic uncertainty suppresses corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% during high unemployment regimes.
